title: Disney raises Disney+ and Hulu prices, the fourth price hike in as many years; the ad-free tiers will each cost $21.49/month, an increase of $2.50 (Rick Porter/The Hollywood Reporter)
summary: Rick Porter / The Hollywood Reporter: Disney raises Disney+ and Hulu prices, the fourth price hike in as many years; the ad-free tiers will each cost $21.49/month, an increase of $2.50 — Subscribing to a bundle is now almost exactly half the price of individual plans for each streamer.
